tip: Each ad fits only once. Check both conditions. x = no ad fits.

exercises.title: Teil 3 · Job & Reisen: situations and ads
exercises.body:
**10 situations · 12 ads.** Each ad fits at most once; **x** = no ad fits.

- Every situation has **two conditions** (*Bedingungen*), e.g. *Deutschkurs + abends*. An ad only fits if it meets **both**.
- Typical traps: the right topic but the wrong time (morning instead of evening), renting instead of buying, the wrong target group (children instead of adults).
- Usually one or two situations have no matching ad: dare to choose x.

A multiple-choice card can show at most 12 options, so for each situation one clearly unrelated ad is left out of the list.
